LESSON: PARABLE OF THE LOST SHEEP

Grade: Grade 5
Subject: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: The Life and Ministry of Jesus Christ
Topic 3.6: Parable of the Lost Sheep

SECTION 1: WELCOME

• Today’s class: Parable of the Lost Sheep
• How we learn: Teach → Worked example → Try this
• Use point notes. Show working. Then take the quiz.
• Big question: Why is the parable of the lost sheep significant to Christians today?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

1. apply the virtues in their interaction with others

SECTION 3: CLASS STUDY (TEACH → EXAMPLE → TRY)

▸ Skill 1: apply the virtues in their interaction with others

Teach
• Today’s focus: apply the virtues in their interaction with others.
• Listen/read the idea.
• Watch/study the model.
• Then do Try this.

Worked example
• Model A for “apply the virtues in their interaction with others” using a school example.
• Model B for “apply the virtues in their interaction with others” using a home/county example.

Try this
• Your turn: show "apply the virtues in their interaction with others" in 3 bullet points.
• Share with a partner and improve one bullet.


SECTION: QUICK EXAMPLES

• Model 1: apply the virtues in their interaction with others

SECTION: PRACTICE NOW

1. Practise: apply the virtues in their interaction with others

SECTION: WORK TO DO

1. Make a one-page revision sheet for Parable of the Lost Sheep.
2. Teach someone at home for 2 minutes using bullet points only.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. Why is the parable of the lost sheep significant to Christians today?
2. How does the Sermon on the Mount foster harmonious co- existence?

SECTION: REMEMBER

• apply the virtues in their interaction with others

• Next: complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.
